description: The bar chart illustrates the number of sentences (in thousands) across various categories related to the Sámi language. The vertical axis represents the number of sentences, labeled as "Sentences (K)," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 900 in increments of 100. The horizontal axis lists the categories: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The bars are colored in shades of red, with the tallest bar representing News at 902 thousand sentences, followed by Administrative at 525 thousand sentences. Religion has the shortest bar with 23 thousand sentences, and Blogs have the second shortest at 2 thousand sentences. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding on the bars, and there is no indication of sorting or grouping beyond the standard bar chart format.
